items.title: 从拒绝 AI 到一切先问 Agent，DHH：这是我最爽的编程时刻之一，但程序员黄金时代到头了
items.raw_excerpt: 六个月前，Ruby on Rails 作者、37signals 联合创始人兼 CTO David Heinemeier Hansson（DHH） 还在访谈中明确表示：他不会用 AI 写代码，所有代码仍然亲手完成。短短半年之后，这一状态已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。

title_i18n.zh: 从拒绝 AI 到一切先问 Agent，DHH：这是我最爽的编程时刻之一，但程序员黄金时代到头了
title_i18n.en: From rejecting AI to consulting an Agent for everything first, DHH: This is one of my most satisfying programming moments, but the golden age for programmers is over.
title_i18n.es: Desde rechazar la IA hasta consultar primero al Agente para todo, DHH: Este es uno de mis momentos de programación más satisfactorios, pero la edad de oro de los programadores ha llegado a su fin.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 六个月前，Ruby on Rails 作者、37signals 联合创始人兼 CTO David Heinemeier Hansson（DHH） 还在访谈中明确表示：他不会用 AI 写代码，所有代码仍然亲手完成。短短半年之后，这一状态已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
excerpt_i18n.en: Six months ago, David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH), creator of Ruby on Rails and co-founder and CTO of 37signals, clearly stated in an interview that he would not use AI to write code and would still complete all code by hand. In just half a year, this situation has undergone a dramatic change.
excerpt_i18n.es: Hace seis meses, David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH), creador de Ruby on Rails, cofundador y CTO de 37signals, afirmó claramente en una entrevista que no usaría IA para escribir código, y que todo el código seguía siendo realizado manualmente. En tan solo medio año, esta situación ha experimentado un cambio radical.

items.title: OQP – A verification protocol for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
As AI agents autonomously write and deploy code, there's no standard for verifying that what they shipped actually satisfies business requirements. OQP is an attempt to define that standard. It's MCP-compatible and defines four core endpoints:
- GET /capabilities — what can this agent verify?
- GET /context/workflows — what are the business rules for this workflow?
- POST /verification/execute — run a verification workflow
- POST /verification/assess-risk — what is the risk of this change? The analogy we keep coming back to: what OpenAPI did for REST APIs, OQP does for agentic software verification. items.title: 不会写代码也能用 AI 干活了：OpenAI 正在做一个“替你用电脑”的 Super App，新模型Spud 几周内登场
items.raw_excerpt: 在外界眼里，视频生成明明还是最容易出圈、最能制造话题的明星业务，但 OpenAI 却选择在这个节点收缩战线，把资源转向一个更大的目标：Super App。它不只是想再做一个更强的 ChatGPT，也不只是想补上 Codex 和浏览器能力，而是想抢先造出那个真正承接 AGI 的总入口，即一个能理解你、代表你、替你操作电脑、接管工作流，甚至逐步“运行”你数字生活的系统。

title_i18n.zh: 不会写代码也能用 AI 干活了：OpenAI 正在做一个“替你用电脑”的 Super App，新模型Spud 几周内登场
title_i18n.en: Even without coding skills, you can now use AI to get work done: OpenAI is developing a "Super App" that acts on your behalf on the computer, with the new model Spud set to launch in a few weeks.
title_i18n.es: Incluso sin saber programar, puedes usar la IA para trabajar: OpenAI está desarrollando una "Super App" que "usa la computadora por ti", y el nuevo modelo Spud llegará en unas semanas.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在外界眼里，视频生成明明还是最容易出圈、最能制造话题的明星业务，但 OpenAI 却选择在这个节点收缩战线，把资源转向一个更大的目标：Super App。它不只是想再做一个更强的 ChatGPT，也不只是想补上 Codex 和浏览器能力，而是想抢先造出那个真正承接 AGI 的总入口，即一个能理解你、代表你、替你操作电脑、接管工作流，甚至逐步“运行”你数字生活的系统。
excerpt_i18n.en: From an external perspective, video generation is still seen as the most likely to go viral and generate buzz. However, OpenAI has chosen to scale back its efforts at this point, redirecting resources toward a larger goal: the Super App. It aims not just to create a more powerful ChatGPT or to enhance capabilities like Codex and browsing, but to pioneer the ultimate gateway to AGI—a system that understands you, represents you, operates your computer, manages workflows, and gradually "runs" your digital life.
excerpt_i18n.es: Desde la perspectiva externa, la generación de vídeo sigue siendo el campo más destacado y generador de debate, pero OpenAI ha decidido en este momento replegar sus esfuerzos y redirigir recursos hacia un objetivo más ambicioso: la Super App. No se trata solo de crear un ChatGPT más potente, ni de complementar las capacidades de Codex y el navegador, sino de adelantarse para construir el portal definitivo que dé cabida a la AGI. Es decir, un sistema capaz de comprenderte, representarte, operar tu ordenador, gestionar tus flujos de trabajo e incluso, gradualmente, "ejecutar" tu vida digital.

items.title: How to build effective reward functions with AWS Lambda for Amazon Nova model customization
items.raw_excerpt: This post demonstrates how Lambda enables scalable, cost-effective reward functions for Amazon Nova customization. You'll learn to choose between Reinforcement Learning via Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for objectively verifiable tasks and Reinforcement Learning via AI Feedback (RLAIF) for subjective evaluation, design multi-dimensional reward systems that help you prevent reward hacking, optimize Lambda functions for training scale, and monitor reward distributions with Amazon CloudWatch. Working code examples and deployment guidance are included to help you start experimenting.
